english.title: Distribute / display visible representation with intent to cause fear of / to provoke violence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) distributed or displayed to **(..SPECIFY PERSON OR ANOTHER..) a writing, sign or visible representation which was threatening, abusive or insulting with intent to cause that person to believe that immediate unlawful violence would be used against

(A)_[him]_
(B)_[her]_

or another by any person, or to provoke the immediate use of unlawful violence by that person or another or whereby that person was likely to believe that such violence would be used, or it was likely that such violence would be provoked
english.legislation: Contrary to Section 4(1) and (4) of the Public Order Act 1986.

english.notes:
(i) There is a power of entry to premises in order to arrest anyone in the act of committing this offence under section 17 of PACE.
(ii) See also offence wording: H701.
(iii) See the CPS charging standards for this offence before preparing any charges.

other.penalty:
Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
